scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix authorizer run typecheck && .venv-quality/bin/mypy --check-untyped-defs --ignore-missing-imports rotation-function/rotate.py scripts/package-python.py
scripts.format:check: terraform fmt -check -recursive && biome format . && .venv-quality/bin/ruff format --check rotation-function scripts
scripts.build: npm --prefix authorizer run build && PATH="$PWD/.venv-quality/bin:$PATH" bash rotation-function/build.sh
scripts.test: npm --prefix authorizer test && .venv-quality/bin/python3 -m unittest discover -s rotation-function/tests -v
